query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='hzi-braunschweig/SORMAS-Project' AND number=2130 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Pseudonymization of sensitive data
data.body:
Prerequisite: #1158

NEW USER RIGHTS: SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_IN_JURISDICTION & SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_OUTSIDE_JURISDICTION
=> Prevent users WITHOUT this right from seeing:
  * Tasks assigned to users on district level or below (Community, Health facility, point of entry)
  * User names of personnel on district level or below (username, first & lastname)
  * Any location information below district level (e.g. the facility of a case)
  * Names of laboratories where samples have been sent to
  * All fields that allow users to type in free text
  * Detailed information about the employee status of cases or contacts

data.title: Pseudonymization of sensitive data [5]
data.body:
Prerequisite: #1158

NEW USER RIGHTS: SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_IN_JURISDICTION & SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_OUTSIDE_JURISDICTION
=> Prevent users WITHOUT this right from seeing:
  * Tasks assigned to users on district level or below (Community, Health facility, point of entry)
  * User names of personnel on district level or below (username, first & lastname)
  * Any location information below district level (e.g. the facility of a case)
  * Names of laboratories where samples have been sent to
  * All fields that allow users to type in free text
  * Detailed information about the employee status of cases or contacts

The default should probably be that every user has the SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_IN_JURISDICTION user right and nobody has the SEE_SENSITIVE_DATA_OUTSIDE_JURISDICTION user right. German servers will need to be manually adjusted.

### Review
@MartinWahnschaffeSymeda

data.title: Pseudonymization of sensitive data [5]
data.body:
New input from HZI:

- [ ] Pseudonymised should not just be emptied; instead, we should display a placeholder text that has a different style than normal text (gray-ish, maybe italic if that doesn't look too bad).
- [ ] For maps (dashboard & statistics), we can't remove the GPS coordinates completely because the cases still need to be displayed there. Instead, we need to keep them, but randomize the last parts so that the accuracy is reduced to an area of about 5 kilometers
- [ ] Don't pseudonymize the Postal Code completely; instead, reduce it to the first three digits

data.title: Pseudonymization of sensitive data [3+2]
data.body:
Things that are probably out of scope for this issue but should be done asap in a follow-up issue:

* It's possible to search for confidential data; e.g. if I have access to a case but not to its personal details, I can still search for its name and get the case as a result
